[[Ryver's Shortbow]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[bow]] dropped by [[Ryver Mossplanter]], a [[boss]] found in the [[Arborstone|Arborstone mission]] and within [[Arborstone (explorable area)|Arborstone explorable area]].

==Stats==
:[[Piercing damage|Piercing Dmg]]: 15-28 (Requires 9 [[Marksmanship]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:Lengthens [[Crippled]] [[duration]] on foes by 33%
:Health +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as a [[Bramble Shortbow]].

==Replica==
Except for the visual appearance, it is possible to create an exact technical replica for this item with:
*One of the following shortbows:
**[[Ascalon Shortbow]] from collectors [[Mourn Drakespur]] or [[Trego Stonebreaker]]
**[[Shortbow (weapon)|Shortbow]] from collectors [[Attendant Nashu]] or [[Healer Silja]] or crafters [[Honglei Sun]] or [[Manzo]]
**[[Composite Shortbow]] from collectors [[Chinwe]] or [[Kaplack]] or crafters [[Aksah]], [[Asiri]], [[Hahbe]], or [[Kol Swordshanks]]
**[[Destroyer Shortbow]] from crafter [[Balthor Coalforge]]
**[[Imperial Shortbow]] from collector [[Shen Xi]]
**[[Tormented Shortbow]] from collector [[Deacon of Whispers]]
*[[Crippling]] [[Bow String]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Bow Grip]] [[of Fortitude]]
OR
*One of the following shortbows:
**Composite Shortbow from crafters [[Asa]], [[Bolereh]], [[Derrick]], [[Hadusi]], [[Rahmdah]], [[Sende]], [[Shausha]], [[Soros]], or [[Tehshan]]
**[[Asuran Shortbow]] from crafter [[Nojj]]
**[[Balthazar's Shortbow]] from collector [[Zaishen Martial Weapon Master]]
**[[Deldrimor Shortbow]] from crafter [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]]
**[[Norn Shortbow]] from crafter [[Keti]]
**[[Oppressor's Shortbow]] from collector [[Lionguard (collector)|Lionguard]]
**[[Shortbow of Purity]] from collector [[Iza Yoi]]
**[[Charr Shortbow]] from collector [[Tuomas]] (requires [[Bonus Mission Pack]])
**[[Mursaat Shortbow]] from collector [[Diane]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)

**[[Undead Shortbow]] from collector [[Archivist of Whispers]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)

== Unique counterpart ==
[[Petraj's Recurve Bow]] and [[Deldrimor Recurve Bow (unique)|Deldrimor Recurve Bow]] have stats identical with this item; however, they are a different bow type.
